mito -use http,collections -log_requests src.cel
stderr 'transaction\.id'
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
get("http://www.example.com/").as(resp, 
	resp.with({
		"Body": resp.Body == b"" ? resp.Body : b"some text",
		"Header": {?"Content-Type": resp.?Header["Content-Type"]},
	})
).drop([
	"ContentLength",
	"TransferEncoding",
	"Uncompressed",
])
-- want.txt --

		]
